annotations.text:
Built as a StreamElements widget.
262px wide, 13px type, Plus Jakarta Sans. Rows are flat pastel fills - no gradients, no glow, no blur.
Done rows turn sage and the tick draws itself; the strikethrough fades in rather than sweeping, so it still works when a task wraps to two lines. Rows slide open when added and collapse when removed.
Every colour, size and gap is a field in the widget settings, so none of it needs a code edit.

Option A - Soft Paper (not chosen)
A warm off-white card, flat sage tick, one hairline progress line. Calmest of the set.
Tradeoff: a light block on a dark stream takes up attention as well as space.

Option B - Muted Dark (not chosen)
Same layout, flat charcoal card, pastel lavender tick.
Tradeoff: sinks into dark gameplay and can disappear over a dark scene.

Option C - No Card (not chosen)
No container at all - just text on the stream. Smallest possible footprint.
Tradeoff: legibility depends entirely on what is behind it.
